+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import pytest
+from PIL import Image
+
+from ...utils import check_logprobs_close
+
+MODEL = "ibm-granite/granite-vision-4.1-4b"
+
+# (width, height) -> anyres tile count with GV4.1's grid (384px tiles + base view):
+# 5, 10 and 7 tiles. Distinct sizes also give distinct hashes, so no image is
+# served from the processor or encoder cache.
+IMAGE_SIZES = ((640, 480), (1300, 876), (1024, 768))
+
+
+def _prompt(num_images: int) -> str:
+    return f"<|user|>\n{'<image>' * num_images}\nDescribe the image.\n<|assistant|>\n"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.core_model
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("max_tokens", [16])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_logprobs", [5])
+def test_mixed_tile_counts_across_requests(
+    vllm_runner,
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+    max_tokens: int,
+    num_logprobs: int,
+) -> None:
+    """Batch requests whose images have different tile counts.
+
+    The first request's 5-tile image is padded to 10 tiles by the HF processor
+    and the second request's image has 7, so when both are encoded together the
+    model receives `pixel_values` as a list of differently shaped tensors.
+    Outputs must match running each request alone, where every encoder batch
+    is a single 5-D tensor.
+    """
+    # In-process engine: both requests are queued before the first engine step,
+    # so their images are encoded in one batch. With a separate engine process
+    # the requests can reach the scheduler in different steps and be encoded
+    # separately, which never reaches the list path.
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING", "0")
+
+    small, large, medium = (
+        Image.new("RGB", size, color)
+        for size, color in zip(IMAGE_SIZES, ("red", "green", "blue"))
+    )
+    prompts = [_prompt(2), _prompt(1)]
+    images = [[small, large], [medium]]
+    runner_kwargs = dict(
+        dtype="bfloat16",
+        enforce_eager=True,
+        max_model_len=8192,
+        limit_mm_per_prompt={"image": 2},
+        # Two engines run one after the other in this process.
+        gpu_memory_utilization=0.4,
+    )
+
+    with vllm_runner(MODEL, **runner_kwargs) as vllm_model:
+        # One call so both requests' images are encoded in the same batch.
+        batched = vllm_model.generate_greedy_logprobs(
+            prompts, max_tokens, num_logprobs=num_logprobs, images=images
+        )
+
+    # Fresh engine, so no encoder or prefix cache entry from the batched run.
+    with vllm_runner(MODEL, **runner_kwargs) as vllm_model:
+        single = [
+            vllm_model.generate_greedy_logprobs(
+                [prompt], max_tokens, num_logprobs=num_logprobs, images=[image]
+            )[0]
+            for prompt, image in zip(prompts, images)
+        ]
+
+    check_logprobs_close(
+        outputs_0_lst=single,
+        outputs_1_lst=batched,
+        name_0="single",
+        name_1="batched",
+    )

+#!/bin/bash
+
+# Run the AMD Zen CPU tests on the zen5 hardware.
+
+set -euox pipefail
+
+# allow to bind to different cores
+CORE_RANGE=${CORE_RANGE:-0-47}
+NUMA_NODE=${NUMA_NODE:-0}
+IMAGE_NAME="zen-cpu-test-$NUMA_NODE"
+FALLBACK_BASE_IMAGE="zen-cpu-base-$NUMA_NODE"
+TIMEOUT_VAL=$1
+TEST_COMMAND=$2
+
+# Install zentorch directly in Dockerfile.zen instead of `uv pip install
+# "vllm[zen]"`, which makes uv re-resolve vLLM and fail on its transitive
+# triton-cpu URL dependency. Keep in sync with the `zen` extra in setup.py.
+ZENTORCH_VERSION="${ZENTORCH_VERSION:-2.14.0.1}"
+
+CLEANUP_IMAGES=()
+cleanup() {
+    if [ "${#CLEANUP_IMAGES[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
+        docker rmi -f "${CLEANUP_IMAGES[@]}" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
+    fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT
+
+# Published images (resolvable only when the Buildkite registry env vars are
+# present, i.e. in CI). Pulls from public ECR are anonymous.
+ZEN_IMAGE=""
+SHARED_CPU_IMAGE=""
+if [ -n "${REGISTRY:-}" ] && [ -n "${REPO:-}" ] && [ -n "${BUILDKITE_COMMIT:-}" ]; then
+    ZEN_IMAGE="$REGISTRY/$REPO:$BUILDKITE_COMMIT-zen-cpu"
+    SHARED_CPU_IMAGE="$REGISTRY/$REPO:$BUILDKITE_COMMIT-cpu"
+fi
+
+if [ -n "$ZEN_IMAGE" ] && docker pull "$ZEN_IMAGE"; then
+    # Fast path: reuse the prebuilt zen image; no local build.
+    echo "--- :docker: Using published Zen image: $ZEN_IMAGE"
+    IMAGE_NAME="$ZEN_IMAGE"
+    CLEANUP_IMAGES+=("$ZEN_IMAGE")
+else
+    # Step 1: obtain the CPU base image that Dockerfile.zen layers on. Prefer
+    # pulling the published `-cpu` image; fall back to building it from source.
+    if [ -n "$SHARED_CPU_IMAGE" ] && docker pull "$SHARED_CPU_IMAGE"; then
+        echo "--- :docker: Using published CPU image as base: $SHARED_CPU_IMAGE"
+        BASE_IMAGE="$SHARED_CPU_IMAGE"
+        CLEANUP_IMAGES+=("$SHARED_CPU_IMAGE")
+    else
+        echo "--- :docker: Published CPU image unavailable; building base from source"
+        docker build --progress plain --tag "$FALLBACK_BASE_IMAGE" \
+            --target vllm-openai -f docker/Dockerfile.cpu .
+        BASE_IMAGE="$FALLBACK_BASE_IMAGE"
+        CLEANUP_IMAGES+=("$FALLBACK_BASE_IMAGE")
+    fi
+
+    # Step 2: build the zen test image on top of the CPU base.
+    echo "--- :docker: Building Zen test image"
+    docker build --progress plain --tag "$IMAGE_NAME" \
+        --build-arg BASE_IMAGE="$BASE_IMAGE" \
+        --build-arg ZENTORCH_VERSION="$ZENTORCH_VERSION" \
+        --target vllm-zen-test -f docker/Dockerfile.zen .
+    CLEANUP_IMAGES+=("$IMAGE_NAME")
+fi
+
+# Run the image, setting --shm-size=4g for tensor parallel. The in-container
+# command verifies the installed zentorch matches the pinned version and that
+# its torch.compile backend is registered (i.e. not the stable-only build), so
+# a mismatch fails loudly instead of silently testing a different zentorch.
+docker run --rm \
+    --cpuset-cpus="$CORE_RANGE" \
+    --cpuset-mems="$NUMA_NODE" \
+    -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface \
+    --privileged=true \
+    -e HF_TOKEN \
+    -e VLLM_CPU_KVCACHE_SPACE=16 \
+    -e VLLM_CPU_CI_ENV=1 \
+    -e VLLM_CPU_SIM_MULTI_NUMA=1 \
+    --shm-size=4g \
+    "$IMAGE_NAME" \
+    timeout "$TIMEOUT_VAL" bash -c "set -euox pipefail
+echo \"--- Print packages\"
+pip list
+echo \"--- Verify zentorch\"
+python -c \"
+import importlib.metadata as m, torch, zentorch
+from torch._dynamo import list_backends
+v = m.version('zentorch')
+assert v == '${ZENTORCH_VERSION}', (
+    'zentorch ' + v + ' != expected ${ZENTORCH_VERSION}'
+)
+assert 'zentorch' in list_backends(), (
+    'zentorch torch.compile backend not registered (stable-only build?)'
+)
+\"
+echo \"--- Running tests\"
+${TEST_COMMAND}"

+else:
+
+    class TokenBuffer(array):
+        """Mutable int32 token ids with no per-token Python objects."""
+
+        __slots__ = ()
+
+        def __new__(cls, tokens: Iterable[int] = ()):
+            if isinstance(tokens, np.ndarray):
+                # A 32-bit int array, as the frontends send, copied as one block.
+                assert tokens.dtype.kind in "iu" and tokens.dtype.itemsize == 4
+                buf = super().__new__(cls, "i")
+                buf.frombytes(memoryview(np.ascontiguousarray(tokens)).cast("B"))
+                return buf
+            # From another array of the same type this is a memcpy.
+            return super().__new__(cls, "i", tokens)
+
+        def __getitem__(self, index):
+            item = array.__getitem__(self, index)
+            return item.tolist() if isinstance(index, slice) else item
+
+        def __eq__(self, other):
+            if isinstance(other, (list, tuple)):
+                return len(self) == len(other) and self.tolist() == as_list(other)
+            return array.__eq__(self, other)
+
+        def __ne__(self, other):
+            return not self == other
+
+        def __add__(self, other):
+            return self.tolist() + as_list(other)
+
+        def __radd__(self, other):
+            return as_list(other) + self.tolist()
+
+        def __iadd__(self, other):
+            self.extend(other)
+            return self
+
+        def copy(self) -> list[int]:
+            return self.tolist()
+
+        def __reduce_ex__(self, protocol):
+            # A PickleBuffer lets MessageQueue send large ids out of band. It wraps
+            # a copy since zmq may hold it past enqueue, blocking resizes of self.
+            data = self.tobytes()

+                PickleBuffer(data) if protocol >= 5 else data,
+            )
+
+    def _rebuild_token_buffer(data) -> TokenBuffer:
+        # data is whatever object pickle was given for the buffer, e.g. bytes,
+        # a bytearray or a zmq.Frame, so copy out of it rather than keep it.
+        tokens = TokenBuffer()

+    dst: list[int], src: Sequence[int], start: int, stop: int

+    TokenBuffers."""
+    if isinstance(dst, array) and isinstance(src, array):
+        dst.extend(array.__getitem__(src, slice(start, stop)))
+    else:
+        dst.extend(src[start:stop])
+
+
+def rfind_tokens(
+    token_ids: Sequence[int],
+    targets: Collection[int | None],
+    start: int = 0,
+    stop: int | None = None,
+) -> int:
+    """Return the index of the last token in ``token_ids[start:stop]`` that is
+    one of ``targets`` (``None`` entries, for absent tokens, are ignored), or -1.
+
+    An int32 buffer (a TokenBuffer) is searched with numpy, in chunks growing
+    back from ``stop`` so a recent match is found quickly, without creating a
+    Python int per token. Other sequences are scanned backwards in Python.
+    """
+    if stop is None:
+        stop = len(token_ids)
+    if isinstance(token_ids, TokenIdsView):
+        return token_ids.rfind(targets, start, stop)
+    if isinstance(token_ids, array) and token_ids.typecode == "i":
+        ids = np.frombuffer(token_ids, dtype=np.int32)
+        wanted = np.array([t for t in targets if t is not None], dtype=np.int32)
+        chunk = 256
+        while stop > start:
+            lo = max(start, stop - chunk)
+            hits = np.flatnonzero(np.isin(ids[lo:stop], wanted))
+            if hits.size:
+                return lo + int(hits[-1])
+            stop, chunk = lo, chunk * 8
+        return -1
+    for i in range(stop - 1, start - 1, -1):
+        if token_ids[i] in targets:
+            return i
+    return -1
+
+
+def rfind_token_sequences(
+    token_ids: Sequence[int],
+    markers: Sequence[Sequence[int | None]],
+    start: int = 0,
+    stop: int | None = None,
+) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """Return ``(index, k)`` for the newest occurrence in ``token_ids[start:stop]``
+    of any of the multi-token ``markers``, ``k`` being its position in
+    ``markers`` (the first listed wins at the same index), or ``(-1, -1)``.
+
+    Candidates are found with rfind_tokens on the markers' first tokens, so a
+    TokenBuffer is searched with numpy and only candidate positions are read.
+    """
+    if stop is None:
+        stop = len(token_ids)
+    marker_lists = [list(marker) for marker in markers]
+    first_ids = {marker[0] for marker in marker_lists if marker}
+    end = stop
+    while (i := rfind_tokens(token_ids, first_ids, start, end)) >= 0:
+        head = token_ids[i]
+        for k, marker in enumerate(marker_lists):
+            if (marker and marker[0] == head and i + len(marker) <= stop) and (
+                len(marker) == 1
+                or as_list(token_ids[i + 1 : i + len(marker)]) == marker[1:]
+            ):
+                return i, k
+        end = i
+    return -1, -1
+

+    """``tokens[start:stop]``; for a TokenBuffer an int32 array, so that no
+    Python ints are made until it is read."""
+    if isinstance(tokens, array):
+        return array.__getitem__(tokens, slice(start, stop))
+    return tokens[start:stop]
+
+
+class TokenIdsView(Sequence[int]):
+    """``tokens`` followed by ``suffix``, shortened from the end by pop().
+
+    Copied into a list only when read element-wise, so a caller that ignores
+    it, or searches it with rfind_tokens, doesn't copy ``tokens``.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, tokens: Sequence[int], suffix: Iterable[int] = ()) -> None:
+        self._tokens = tokens
+        self._suffix = list(suffix)
+        self._len = len(tokens) + len(self._suffix)
+        self._list: list[int] | None = None
+
+    def __len__(self) -> int:
+        return self._len
+
+    def _as_list(self) -> list[int]:
+        if self._list is None:
+            num_tokens = min(len(self._tokens), self._len)
+            self._list = list(self._tokens[:num_tokens])
+            self._list.extend(self._suffix[: self._len - num_tokens])
+        return self._list
+
+    @overload
+    def __getitem__(self, index: int) -> int: ...
+
+    @overload
+    def __getitem__(self, index: slice) -> list[int]: ...
+
+    def __getitem__(self, index: int | slice) -> int | list[int]:
+        return self._as_list()[index]
+
+    def __iter__(self) -> Iterator[int]:
+        return iter(self._as_list())
+
+    def __contains__(self, value: object) -> bool:
+        return value in self._as_list()
+
+    def pop(self) -> None:
+        if self._list is not None:
+            self._list.pop()
+        self._len -= 1
+
+    def rfind(self, targets: Collection[int | None], start: int, stop: int) -> int:
+        if self._list is not None:
+            return rfind_tokens(self._list, targets, start, stop)
+        num_tokens = len(self._tokens)
+        stop = min(stop, self._len)
+        for i in range(stop - 1, max(start, num_tokens) - 1, -1):
+            if self._suffix[i - num_tokens] in targets:
+                return i
+        return rfind_tokens(self._tokens, targets, start, min(stop, num_tokens))

+def _verify_reference(q, cache, block_table, seq_lens, real_seq_lens, qlen, scale):
+    """Causal MLA verify in the dtype of ``cache``: row t of a request attends
+    its first min(L - qlen + 1 + t, L_real) tokens; a row with none comes back
+    zero. A bf16 ``cache`` also rounds P to bf16 before the PV product, as the
+    kernel does."""
+    kv_lora_rank = 512
+    page_size = cache.shape[1]
+    lowp = cache.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    dtype = torch.float32 if lowp else cache.dtype
+    out = torch.zeros(
+        q.shape[0], q.shape[1], kv_lora_rank, dtype=dtype, device=q.device
+    )
+    for b, seq_len in enumerate(seq_lens.tolist()):
+        real = seq_len if real_seq_lens is None else real_seq_lens[b].item()
+        lim = (torch.arange(qlen) + seq_len - qlen + 1).clamp(0, real).tolist()
+        if max(lim) == 0:
+            continue
+        num_pages = cdiv(seq_len, page_size)
+        kv = cache[block_table[b, :num_pages].long()].reshape(-1, cache.shape[-1])
+        kv = kv[: max(lim)].to(dtype)
+        rows = slice(b * qlen, (b + 1) * qlen)
+        s = torch.einsum("thd,kd->thk", q[rows].to(dtype), kv) * scale
+        keys = torch.arange(kv.shape[0], device=q.device)
+        hidden = keys[None, :] >= torch.tensor(lim, device=q.device)[:, None]
+        s = s.masked_fill(hidden[:, None, :], float("-inf"))
+        p = torch.exp(s - s.amax(-1, keepdim=True)).nan_to_num(0.0)
+        pv = p.bfloat16().to(dtype) if lowp else p
+        o = torch.einsum("thk,kd->thd", pv, kv[:, :kv_lora_rank])
+        out[rows] = o / p.sum(-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-30)
+    return out.bfloat16().to(dtype) if lowp else out

+    num_pages = first_high + 2 * pages_per_req
+    if torch.accelerator.get_memory_info()[0] < num_pages * page_size * dim + 2**30:

+    block_table = high.view(2, pages_per_req).to(torch.int32)
+    data = torch.randn(2 * pages_per_req, page_size, 1, dim, device=DEVICE_TYPE)
+    big[high] = data.to(fp8)

+    tok = q_row % QLEN
+
+    seq_len = tl.load(B_Seqlen + cur_batch)
+    L_cap = seq_len
+    if HAS_REAL:
+        L_cap = tl.minimum(seq_len, tl.load(Real_Seqlen + cur_batch))
+    L_cap = tl.maximum(L_cap, 0)
+    lim = tl.maximum(tl.minimum(seq_len - QLEN + 1 + tok, L_cap), 0)
+    per_split = _verify_split_len(L_cap, NUM_KV_SPLITS, SPLIT_ALIGN, MIN_SPLIT_LEN)
+    num_active = tl.cdiv(lim, per_split)
+
+    offs_d = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_DV)
+    offs_s = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_S)
+    base = q_row.to(tl.int64) * stride_mid_ob + head * stride_mid_oh
+
+    e_max = -float("inf")
+    e_sum = 0.0
+    acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_DV], dtype=tl.float32)
+    for s0 in range(0, num_active, BLOCK_S):
+        sid = s0 + offs_s
+        mask_s = sid < num_active
+        off = base + sid * stride_mid_os
+        tlogic = tl.load(Mid_O + off + Lv, mask=mask_s, other=float("-inf"))
+        tv = tl.load(
+            Mid_O + off[:, None] + offs_d[None, :], mask=mask_s[:, None], other=0.0
+        )
+        n_e_max = tl.maximum(tl.max(tlogic, 0), e_max)
+        old_scale = tl.exp2(e_max - n_e_max)
+        w = tl.exp2(tlogic - n_e_max)
+        acc = acc * old_scale + tl.sum(w[:, None] * tv, 0)
+        e_sum = e_sum * old_scale + tl.sum(w, 0)
+        e_max = n_e_max
+
+    has = e_sum > 0.0
+    denom = tl.where(has, e_sum, 1.0)
+    tl.store(
+        o + q_row.to(tl.int64) * stride_obs + head * stride_oh + offs_d,
+        (acc / denom).to(o.dtype.element_ty),
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        lse + q_row.to(tl.int64) * stride_lse_bs + head * stride_lse_h,
+        tl.where(has, (e_max + tl.log2(denom)) * _LN2, float("-inf")),
+    )
+
+
+VERIFY_DEFAULT_CONFIG: dict[str, Any] = dict(
+    BLOCK_H=32,
+    BLOCK_N=16,
+    num_warps=4,
+    num_stages=1,
+    waves_per_eu=1,
+    matrix_instr_nonkdim=16,
+    kpack=2,
+    SPLIT_ALIGN=16,
+    MIN_SPLIT_LEN=256,
+    QSPLIT=False,
+    S2_BLOCK_S=16,
+    s2_num_warps=4,
+)
+
+
+def verify_row_blocks(qlen: int, num_heads: int, block_h: int) -> int:
+    return triton.cdiv(qlen * num_heads, block_h)
+
+
+def verify_num_kv_splits(
+    max_seq_len: int,
+    batch: int,
+    qlen: int,
+    num_heads: int,
+    sm_count: int,
+    block_h: int = VERIFY_DEFAULT_CONFIG["BLOCK_H"],
+    occupancy: float = 1.0,
+    min_work_per_split: int = 64,
+    max_splits: int = 8,
+) -> int:
+    """Static upper bound on KV splits (safe to bake into a cudagraph).
+
+    The kernel splits each request's own length into
+    max(cdiv(L, splits), MIN_SPLIT_LEN) chunks, so this only caps the split
+    count. ``occupancy`` is the number of resident stage-1 programs per CU.
+    If one split of every request fits in a single dispatch round, use as many
+    splits as fit in that round; otherwise pick n <= max_splits minimising
+    rounds(n) / n (the idle tail of the last round), preferring fewer splits
+    within 5% of the best.
+    """
+    programs_per_split = max(1, batch) * verify_row_blocks(qlen, num_heads, block_h)
+    ideal = triton.cdiv(max(1, max_seq_len), max(1, min_work_per_split))
+    slots = max(1, int(occupancy * sm_count))
+    if programs_per_split <= slots:
+        n = slots // programs_per_split
+    else:
+        cost = [
+            (triton.cdiv(n * programs_per_split, slots) / n, n)
+            for n in range(1, max(1, min(ideal, max_splits)) + 1)
+        ]
+        best = min(c for c, _ in cost)
+        n = min(n for c, n in cost if c <= best * 1.05)
+    return max(1, min(ideal, n, sm_count * 2))
+
+
+def decode_attention_fwd_verify(
+    q,
+    k_buffer,
+    v_buffer,
+    o,
+    lse,
+    req_to_token,
+    seq_lens,
+    real_seq_lens,
+    qlen,
+    attn_logits,
+    num_kv_splits,
+    sm_scale,
+    page_size,
+    k_scale=None,
+):
+    """Causal MLA verify over a per-request block table.
+
+    Args:
+        q: [B * qlen, H, Lk] queries, verify tokens of a request contiguous.
+        k_buffer: paged latent cache, [num_pages, page_size, 1, Lk] (or 3D
+            [num_pages * page_size, 1, Lk]).
+        v_buffer: k_buffer[..., :Lv] (V is read from K; only its width is used).
+        o: [B * qlen, H, Lv] output.
+        lse: [B * qlen, H] fp32 natural-log LSE (-inf for rows with no key).
+        req_to_token: [B, max_pages] per-request block table (not repeated).
+        seq_lens: [B] int32 kernel KV lengths L.
+        real_seq_lens: [B] int32 or None; row limit is
+            max(min(L - qlen + 1 + t, L_real), 0).
+        qlen: verify tokens per request.
+        attn_logits: fp32 workspace with >= B * qlen * H * num_kv_splits *
+            (Lv + 1) elements, laid out [B * qlen, H, num_kv_splits, Lv + 1].
+            Unused, and may be None, when num_kv_splits is 1.
+        num_kv_splits: static cap on KV splits per request (see
+            verify_num_kv_splits); shorter requests use fewer, longer splits.
+        sm_scale: softmax scale.
+        page_size: tokens per KV cache page.
+        k_scale: scalar tensor dequantizing an FP8 cache; ignored for bf16.
+
+    """
+    cfg = select_verify_config(q.shape[0] // qlen, qlen, q.shape[1])
+    Lk = k_buffer.shape[-1]
+    Lv = v_buffer.shape[-1]
+    assert k_buffer.shape[-2] == 1, "verify path expects a single latent KV head"
+    num_rows, num_heads = q.shape[0], q.shape[1]
+    assert num_rows % qlen == 0
+    batch = num_rows // qlen
+    if num_kv_splits == 1:
+        # Stage 1 writes o / lse directly; o only stands in for the pointer.
+        attn_logits, mid_strides = o, (0, 0, 0)
+    else:
+        assert attn_logits.shape[-2] == num_kv_splits
+        mid_strides = attn_logits.stride()[:3]
+    if k_scale is None:
+        k_scale = torch.ones((), dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
+    BLOCK_DMODEL = triton.next_power_of_2(Lv)
+    BLOCK_DPE = triton.next_power_of_2(Lk - Lv) if Lk > Lv else 0
+    assert Lv == BLOCK_DMODEL and Lk == BLOCK_DMODEL + BLOCK_DPE
+    has_real = real_seq_lens is not None
+    real = real_seq_lens if has_real else seq_lens
+
+    hip_kw = {}
+    if is_hip_:
+        hip_kw = dict(
+            waves_per_eu=cfg["waves_per_eu"],
+            matrix_instr_nonkdim=cfg["matrix_instr_nonkdim"],
+            kpack=cfg["kpack"],
+        )
+    grid = (verify_row_blocks(qlen, num_heads, cfg["BLOCK_H"]) * batch * num_kv_splits,)
+    _fwd_verify_kernel_stage1[grid](
+        q,
+        k_buffer,
+        sm_scale * _LOG2E,
+        req_to_token,
+        seq_lens,
+        real,
+        attn_logits,
+        o,
+        lse,
+        req_to_token.stride(0),
+        q.stride(0),
+        q.stride(1),
+        _page_stride(k_buffer, page_size),
+        k_buffer.stride(-3),
+        *mid_strides,
+        o.stride(0),
+        o.stride(1),
+        lse.stride(0),
+        lse.stride(1),
+        k_scale,
+        batch,
+        QLEN=qlen,
+        NUM_HEADS=num_heads,
+        HAS_REAL=has_real,
+        BLOCK_DMODEL=BLOCK_DMODEL,
+        BLOCK_DPE=BLOCK_DPE,
+        BLOCK_N=cfg["BLOCK_N"],
+        BLOCK_H=cfg["BLOCK_H"],
+        NUM_KV_SPLITS=num_kv_splits,
+        SPLIT_ALIGN=cfg["SPLIT_ALIGN"],
+        MIN_SPLIT_LEN=cfg["MIN_SPLIT_LEN"],
+        PAGE_SIZE=page_size,
+        Lv=Lv,
+        QSPLIT=bool(cfg["QSPLIT"]),
+        SINGLE=num_kv_splits == 1,
+        num_warps=cfg["num_warps"],
+        num_stages=cfg["num_stages"],
+        **hip_kw,
+    )
+    if num_kv_splits == 1:
+        return  # stage 1 wrote o / lse
+    _fwd_verify_kernel_stage2[(num_rows, num_heads)](
+        attn_logits,
+        o,
+        lse,
+        seq_lens,
+        real,
+        attn_logits.stride(0),
+        attn_logits.stride(1),
+        attn_logits.stride(2),
+        o.stride(0),
+        o.stride(1),
+        lse.stride(0),
+        lse.stride(1),
+        QLEN=qlen,
+        HAS_REAL=has_real,
+        NUM_KV_SPLITS=num_kv_splits,
+        SPLIT_ALIGN=cfg["SPLIT_ALIGN"],
+        MIN_SPLIT_LEN=cfg["MIN_SPLIT_LEN"],
+        BLOCK_S=cfg["S2_BLOCK_S"],
+        BLOCK_DV=triton.next_power_of_2(Lv),
+        Lv=Lv,
+        num_warps=cfg["s2_num_warps"],
+        num_stages=1,
+    )
+
+
+_VERIFY_SMALL_CONFIG: dict[str, Any] = dict(
+    BLOCK_H=32, BLOCK_N=32, num_warps=4, kpack=1, MIN_SPLIT_LEN=128, occupancy=2.0
+)
+# 64-row tiles, Q and the QK operand split in two 256-wide halves (QSPLIT,
+# which also enables the K/V prefetch), 32 keys per step on 4 warps. 8 warps
+# cap VGPRs at 256 and spill or idle MFMA rows here.
+_VERIFY_LARGE_CONFIG: dict[str, Any] = dict(
+    BLOCK_H=64,
+    BLOCK_N=32,
+    num_warps=4,
+    QSPLIT=True,
+    MIN_SPLIT_LEN=128,
+    occupancy=1.0,
+)
+
+
+_VERIFY_SMALL_MAX_ROWS = 640
+
+
+def select_verify_config(batch: int, qlen: int, num_heads: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Launch config from MI300X (gfx942) sweeps, bf16, page 16.
+
+    Few rows (B * qlen * H <= 640): 32-row tiles with more KV splits fill the
+    GPU. Otherwise 64-row tiles (Q split in two 256-wide halves, next K/V
+    tile prefetched) halve the KV re-reads per request.
+    """
+    cfg = dict(VERIFY_DEFAULT_CONFIG)
+    if batch * qlen * num_heads <= _VERIFY_SMALL_MAX_ROWS:
+        cfg.update(_VERIFY_SMALL_CONFIG)
+    else:
+        cfg.update(_VERIFY_LARGE_CONFIG)
+    return cfg
+
+
+def _storage_view(t, shape):
+    """Contiguous ``shape`` over ``t``'s storage, or a new tensor if too small."""
+    if math.prod(shape) > t.untyped_storage().nbytes() // t.element_size():
+        return t.new_empty(shape)
+    strides = [1]
+    for size in reversed(shape[1:]):
+        strides.insert(0, strides[0] * size)
+    return torch.as_strided(t, shape, strides, 0)
+
+
+def warmup_decode_attention_fwd_verify(
+    q,
+    k_buffer,
+    o,
+    lse,
+    req_to_token,
+    has_real,
+    qlens,
+    attn_logits,
+    sm_scale,
+    page_size,
+    k_scale=None,
+):
+    """Compile every launch variant serving can reach for these tensors.
+
+    A launch specializes on qlen, the row-count config and a single split, but
+    graph capture and profiling only run the full verify length. Each variant
+    runs once on scratch tensors with the strides of the real ones; the split
+    scratch reuses attn_logits' storage, whose size the launch specializes on.
+    """
+    num_heads, Lv = q.shape[1], o.shape[-1]
+    if attn_logits is None:
+        attn_logits = q.new_empty(0, dtype=torch.float32)
+
+    def scratch(t, rows):
+        return torch.empty_strided(
+            (rows, *t.shape[1:]), t.stride(), dtype=t.dtype, device=t.device
+        )
+
+    for qlen in qlens:
+        for batch in {1, _VERIFY_SMALL_MAX_ROWS // (qlen * num_heads) + 1}:
+            rows = batch * qlen
+            seq_lens = torch.full((batch,), qlen, dtype=torch.int32, device=q.device)
+            block_table = torch.empty_strided(
+                (batch, req_to_token.shape[1]),
+                req_to_token.stride(),
+                dtype=req_to_token.dtype,
+                device=req_to_token.device,
+            ).zero_()
+            for num_kv_splits in (1, 2):
+                decode_attention_fwd_verify(
+                    scratch(q, rows).zero_(),
+                    k_buffer,
+                    k_buffer[..., :Lv],
+                    scratch(o, rows),
+                    scratch(lse, rows),
+                    block_table,
+                    seq_lens,
+                    seq_lens if has_real else None,
+                    qlen,
+                    None
+                    if num_kv_splits == 1
+                    else _storage_view(
+                        attn_logits, (rows, num_heads, num_kv_splits, Lv + 1)
+                    ),
+                    num_kv_splits,
+                    sm_scale,
+                    page_size,
+                    k_scale=k_scale,
+                )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""GLM-5.3-Flash MegaMoE: block-FP8 checkpoint shards requantized to the
+MXFP8 MegaMoE kernel layout."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.deep_gemm_mega_moe import MegaMoEActivation
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.mxfp8_utils import (
+    requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.reload import (
+    finish_reload,
+    record_metadata_for_reloading,
+    start_reload,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.utils import process_weights_after_loading
+from vllm.models.glm5next.nvidia.mega_moe import Glm5NextMegaMoEExperts
+
+BLOCK = (128, 128)
+HIDDEN, INTER = 256, 128
+FP8 = torch.float8_e4m3fn
+NUM_EXPERTS = 4
+# Global ids of the experts _experts() places on this rank.
+LOCAL_EXPERTS = slice(2, 4)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def sm100_mega_moe_layout(monkeypatch):
+    """Build the SM100 kernel layout on any device."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        "vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.deep_gemm_mega_moe."
+        "check_deep_gemm_mega_moe_supported",
+        lambda *args: None,
+    )
+
+
+def _block_fp8(real: torch.Tensor, power_of_two: bool = False):
+    """Quantize ``(..., mn, k)`` to E4M3 with one float32 scale per 128x128."""
+    *lead, mn, k = real.shape
+    blocks = real.reshape(*lead, mn // 128, 128, k // 128, 128)
+    scale = blocks.abs().amax(dim=(-3, -1)) / 448.0
+    if power_of_two:
+        scale = torch.exp2(torch.ceil(torch.log2(scale)))
+    full = scale.repeat_interleave(128, -2).repeat_interleave(128, -1)
+    return (real / full).to(FP8), scale
+
+
+def _dequant_block(weight: torch.Tensor, scale: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return weight.float() * scale.repeat_interleave(128, -2).repeat_interleave(128, -1)
+
+
+def _dequant_ue8m0(weight: torch.Tensor, sf: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return weight.float() * torch.exp2(sf.float() - 127).repeat_interleave(32, -1)
+
+
+def test_requant_is_exact_for_power_of_two_block_scales():
+    torch.manual_seed(1)
+    real = torch.randn(1, 256, 256) * 0.05
+    weight, scale = _block_fp8(real, power_of_two=True)
+
+    requant, sf = requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0(weight, scale)
+
+    # A finer power-of-two scale only shifts exponents, so nothing rounds.
+    assert torch.equal(_dequant_ue8m0(requant, sf), _dequant_block(weight, scale))
+
+
+def _experts() -> Glm5NextMegaMoEExperts:
+    vllm_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        scheduler_config=SimpleNamespace(max_num_batched_tokens=64),
+        compilation_config=SimpleNamespace(static_forward_context={}),
+    )
+    return Glm5NextMegaMoEExperts(
+        vllm_config,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+        num_experts=NUM_EXPERTS,
+        num_local_experts=2,
+        experts_start_idx=2,
+        top_k=2,
+        hidden_size=HIDDEN,
+        intermediate_size=INTER,
+        weight_block_size=BLOCK,
+        activation=MegaMoEActivation("swiglu", clamp=10.0),
+        num_shared_experts=1,
+        prefix="model.layers.3.mlp.experts",
+    )
+
+
+def _checkpoint(seed: int) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Block-FP8 experts as stored: gate rows, then up rows, for w13."""
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+
+    def rand(*shape):
+        return torch.randn(*shape, generator=generator) * 0.02
+
+    w13, s13 = _block_fp8(rand(NUM_EXPERTS, 2 * INTER, HIDDEN))
+    w2, s2 = _block_fp8(rand(NUM_EXPERTS, HIDDEN, INTER))
+    return {
+        "w13_weight": w13,
+        "w13_weight_scale_inv": s13,
+        "w2_weight": w2,
+        "w2_weight_scale_inv": s2,
+    }
+
+
+def _load_shuffled(experts, ckpt, seed, suffix="") -> None:
+    """Load the checkpoint tensors whose names end in ``suffix``, shuffled."""
+    shards = []
+    for expert_id in range(NUM_EXPERTS):
+        for name, tensor in ckpt.items():
+            if not name.endswith(suffix):
+                continue
+            if name.startswith("w2_"):
+                shards.append((name, tensor[expert_id], "w2", expert_id))
+            else:
+                half = tensor.shape[1] // 2
+                shards.append((name, tensor[expert_id, :half], "w1", expert_id))
+                shards.append((name, tensor[expert_id, half:], "w3", expert_id))
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    for i in torch.randperm(len(shards), generator=generator).tolist():
+        name, loaded_weight, shard_id, expert_id = shards[i]
+        param = getattr(experts, name)
+        loaded = param.weight_loader(
+            param,
+            loaded_weight,
+            f"experts.{name}",
+            shard_id=shard_id,
+            expert_id=expert_id,
+            return_success=True,
+        )
+        # Physical experts 2 and 3 are this rank's.
+        assert loaded == (expert_id >= 2)
+
+
+def _reference_mega_moe_layout(w13, s13, w2, s2):
+    """CPU copy of DeepGEMM's transform_weights_for_mega_moe on packed scales."""
+
+    def interleave(t):
+        g, n, k = t.shape
+        halves = t.view(g, 2, n // 16, 8, k)
+        return torch.stack([halves[:, 0], halves[:, 1]], dim=2).reshape(g, n, k)
+
+    def utccp(sf):
+        g, mn, k = sf.shape
+        return sf.reshape(g, -1, 4, 32, k).transpose(2, 3).reshape(g, mn, k)
+
+    return (
+        interleave(w13.view(torch.uint8)),
+        utccp(interleave(s13.view(torch.int32))),
+        w2.view(torch.uint8),
+        utccp(s2.view(torch.int32)),
+    )
+
+
+def _expected_routed(ckpt):
+    w13, s13 = requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0(
+        ckpt["w13_weight"][LOCAL_EXPERTS], ckpt["w13_weight_scale_inv"][LOCAL_EXPERTS]
+    )
+    w2, s2 = requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0(
+        ckpt["w2_weight"][LOCAL_EXPERTS], ckpt["w2_weight_scale_inv"][LOCAL_EXPERTS]
+    )
+    return _reference_mega_moe_layout(w13, s13, w2, s2)
+
+
+def _assert_layout(actual, expected):
+    for tensor, reference in zip(actual, expected):
+        assert torch.equal(tensor.view(reference.dtype), reference)
+
+
+def _routed(experts):
+    return (*experts.l1_weights, *experts.l2_weights)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("first", ["weight", "weight_scale_inv"])
+def test_weight_update_split_across_calls(first):
+    """A weight update may send weights and block scales in separate
+    load_weights calls. The finish step rejects a shard still missing its
+    other half and requantizes each shard once both are in."""
+    experts = _experts()
+    _load_shuffled(experts, _checkpoint(seed=0), seed=0)
+    experts.requantize_block_fp8()
+
+    ckpt = _checkpoint(seed=1)
+    second = "weight_scale_inv" if first == "weight" else "weight"
+    _load_shuffled(experts, ckpt, seed=1, suffix=first)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="without their weight or block scale"):
+        experts.requantize_block_fp8()
+    _load_shuffled(experts, ckpt, seed=2, suffix=second)
+    experts.requantize_block_fp8()
+
+    _assert_layout(_routed(experts), _expected_routed(ckpt))
+
+
+def _shared_checkpoint(seed: int) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    w13, s13 = _block_fp8(torch.randn(1, 2 * INTER, HIDDEN, generator=generator) * 0.02)
+    w2, s2 = _block_fp8(torch.randn(1, HIDDEN, INTER, generator=generator) * 0.02)
+    return {"w13": w13, "s13": s13, "w2": w2, "s2": s2}
+
+
+def _load_shared(experts, ckpt) -> None:
+    w13, s13, w2, s2 = ckpt["w13"], ckpt["s13"], ckpt["w2"], ckpt["s2"]
+    params = {f"mlp.experts.{n}" for n, _ in experts.named_parameters()}
+    for name, data in [
+        ("down_proj.weight_scale_inv", s2[0]),
+        ("gate_proj.weight", w13[0, :INTER]),
+        ("up_proj.weight_scale_inv", s13[0, 1:]),
+        ("down_proj.weight", w2[0]),
+        ("up_proj.weight", w13[0, INTER:]),
+        ("gate_proj.weight_scale_inv", s13[0, :1]),

+                )
+                for w, _, _ in tensors
+            ]
+        )
+        block_scale = torch.stack(
+            [self._shard_rows(s, shard_id) for _, _, s in tensors]
+        )
+        # Power-of-two block scales requantize exactly; any other is rounded.
+        if not torch.equal(block_scale, block_scale.log2().round().exp2()):
+            logger.warning_once(
+                "GLM-5.3-Flash on the deep_gemm_mega_moe backend: the checkpoint's "
+                "%dx%d block-FP8 MoE scales are not all powers of two, so "
+                "requantizing them to MXFP8 (UE8M0 scales per 1x32) changes the "
+                "expert weights. Use another moe_backend to run the block-FP8 "
+                "weights as they are.",
+                *self.weight_block_size,
+            )
+        weight, sf = requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0(raw, block_scale)
+        for (dst, dst_scale, _), w, s in zip(tensors, weight, sf):
+            self._load_weight(dst, w, shard_id, False)
+            self._load_weight(dst_scale, s, shard_id, True)
+

+Glm5NextMegaMoEExperts.weight_loader.supports_moe_loading = True  # type: ignore[attr-defined]

+"""FlashInfer GQA builder: TRTLLM prefill metadata must be CUDA-graph safe."""
+

+from vllm.platforms import current_platform

+if not current_platform.is_cuda():

+import torch

+def test_trtllm_prefill_query_offsets_use_a_persistent_buffer(monkeypatch):
+    """A uniform batch wider than reorder_batch_threshold (e.g. the draft-model
+    prefill, num_speculative_tokens + 2 tokens per request) takes the TRTLLM
+    prefill path and can be captured in a FULL CUDA graph. The graph keeps the
+    address of cum_seq_lens_q from capture time, so every build must write the
+    offsets into the same buffer instead of allocating a new tensor.
+    """

+        method="ngram", num_speculative_tokens=3

+    )

+                window_left=-1, logits_soft_cap=None, sm_scale=0.1, has_sinks=False
+            )
+        },
+    )
+
+    block_size = 16
+    kv_cache_spec = FullAttentionSpec(
+        block_size=block_size,
+        num_kv_heads=vllm_config.model_config.get_num_kv_heads(
+            vllm_config.parallel_config

+        head_size=vllm_config.model_config.get_head_size(),
+        dtype=vllm_config.model_config.dtype,
+    )

+        builder = FlashInferMetadataBuilder(
+            kv_cache_spec, ["layer.0"], vllm_config, device
+        )
+    query_len = builder.reorder_batch_threshold + 1
+
+    # Keep every build's offsets alive so a fresh allocation cannot reuse the
+    # previous address.
+    offsets = []
+    for num_reqs in (4, 3):
+        common = create_common_attn_metadata(
+            BatchSpec(seq_lens=[64] * num_reqs, query_lens=[query_len] * num_reqs),
+            block_size,
+            device,
+        )
+        metadata = builder.build(0, common)
+        assert metadata.num_decodes == 0
+        assert isinstance(metadata.prefill, TRTLLMPrefill)
+        cum_seq_lens_q = metadata.prefill.cum_seq_lens_q

@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+name: pip-compile drift check
+
+# pre-commit only runs the pip-compile hooks when their inputs change. This
+# re-resolves every lockfile daily so a stale one on main does not go unnoticed.
+on:
+  schedule:
+    # Daily at 3:30 AM UTC
+    - cron: '30 3 * * *'
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  pip-compile:
+    if: github.repository_owner == 'vllm-project'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
+    - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@68559e99cc807c1eb7e9238fd43a15bba460eec2 # v10.3.3
+      with:
+        python-version: "3.12"
+    - name: Re-resolve all lockfiles (retries index errors)
+      run: |
+        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
+          if uvx pre-commit run pip-compile --hook-stage manual --all-files --show-diff-on-failure --color=always; then
+            exit 0
+          fi
+          # A failed attempt may have rewritten the lockfiles; reset them so a
+          # retry cannot pass on files the previous attempt fixed up.
+          git checkout -- requirements
+          if [ "$attempt" -lt 3 ]; then
+            sleep 60
+          fi
+        done
+        exit 1

 Choose a value that divides the block size of every prefix-cacheable KV cache group, and that is a multiple of the per-state compression ratio for models that use one, such as sparse MLA. vLLM validates both at startup and names the offending sizes in the error. Read the served block size from the startup log. 64 is a reasonable starting point.
 
+### FlashInfer ReplaySSM
+
+FlashInfer ReplaySSM caches recent inputs to reduce full-state writes during Mamba2 decoding. It is disabled by default. Both Model Runners V1 and V2 support prefix caching with ReplaySSM, including MTP speculative decoding.
+
+This example enables ReplaySSM and prefix caching with three MTP draft tokens:
+
+```bash
+VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 vllm serve nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-NVFP4 \
+    --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
+    --max-model-len 12288 \
+    --dtype bfloat16 \
+    --mamba-backend flashinfer \
+    --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype float16 \
+    --enable-mamba-cache-stochastic-rounding \
+    --mamba-cache-philox-rounds 5 \
+    --use-replayssm \
+    --replayssm-buffer-len 16 \
+    --enable-prefix-caching \
+    --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}'
+```
+
+`--enable-prefix-caching` selects Mamba cache mode `align`. To use ReplaySSM without prefix caching, replace this flag with `--no-enable-prefix-caching`. This selects mode `none`. To disable speculative decoding, remove `--speculative-config`.
+
+FlashInfer ReplaySSM has these limits:
+
+- `align` requires BF16 model inputs for its replay rings. The SSM state dtype is independent. The example uses FP16 state with stochastic rounding.
+- The logical replay buffer cannot exceed 16 tokens. For speculative decoding, it must contain at least `1 + num_speculative_tokens` tokens.
+- Pipeline parallelism, microbatching, and KV connectors are not supported.
+
+Prefix reuse still requires a shared prefix with a saved Mamba checkpoint. The matching rules for hybrid Mamba models above also apply.
+

+def test_replayssm_postprocess_commits_staged_transition(post_step):
+    """Keep group histories equal across checkpoints without touching other slots."""
+    ring_start = [_cuda_ints([11, 3, 7, 13]), _cuda_ints([11, 7, 3, 13])]
+    committed = [_cuda_ints([9, 2, 9, 17]), _cuda_ints([9, 9, 2, 17])]
+    cache = (
+        torch.empty(4, 1, device="cuda"),
+        torch.empty(4, 1, 1, 1, device="cuda"),
+        torch.empty(4, 1, 20, 1, device="cuda"),
+        torch.empty(4, 1, 20, device="cuda"),
+        torch.empty(4, 1, 20, 1, device="cuda"),
+    )
+    spec = MambaSpec(
+        block_size=256,
+        shapes=tuple(tensor.shape[1:] for tensor in cache),
+        dtypes=tuple(tensor.dtype for tensor in cache),
+        mamba_cache_mode="none",
+    )
+    # Neighboring request rows provide valid canary IDs, making erroneous
+    # column reads deterministically corrupt another slot rather than crash.
+    block_tables = [
+        torch.full((256, 1), 3, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda") for _ in range(2)
+    ]
+    grouped = []
+    for group_idx, table in enumerate(block_tables):
+        table[0, 0] = group_idx + 1
+        mixer = _replayssm_mixer(
+            cache,
+            ring_start[group_idx],
+            committed[group_idx],
+            torch.empty(1, device="cuda"),
+        )
+        grouped.append(([mixer], spec, table))
+    context = ReplaySSMModelContext.create(grouped, max_num_reqs=1)
+    computed = 50_000
+    history_tokens = checkpoint_tokens = 0
+    # Reset a later prefill chunk, then reject, partially accept, and fully accept.
+    for step, accepted in enumerate([1] + [4, 1, 3, 2] * 5):
+        prefilling = step == 0
+        query_len = 4
+        if not prefilling:
+            if history_tokens - checkpoint_tokens + query_len > 16:
+                checkpoint_tokens = history_tokens
+            history_tokens += accepted
+        computed_after = computed + (query_len if prefilling else accepted)
+        context.postprocess(
+            idx_mapping=_cuda_ints([0]) if post_step else None,
+            query_metadata=_cuda_ints([0, query_len])
+            if post_step
+            else _cuda_ints([query_len]),
+            query_metadata_is_cumulative=post_step,
+            num_computed_tokens=_cuda_ints([computed_after if post_step else computed]),
+            num_computed_is_post_step=post_step,
+            num_accepted_tokens=_cuda_ints([accepted]),
+            is_prefilling=torch.tensor([prefilling], device="cuda"),
+            live_cols=None,
+            num_reqs=1,
+        )
+        expected_committed = history_tokens - checkpoint_tokens
+        expected_start = checkpoint_tokens % 20
+        for group_idx in range(2):
+            expected_starts, expected_counts = [11, 7, 7, 13], [9, 9, 9, 17]
+            expected_starts[group_idx + 1] = expected_start
+            expected_counts[group_idx + 1] = expected_committed
+            assert ring_start[group_idx].tolist() == expected_starts, step
+            assert committed[group_idx].tolist() == expected_counts, step
+        assert ring_start[0][1].item() == ring_start[1][2].item()
+        assert committed[0][1].item() == committed[1][2].item()
+        assert 0 <= expected_committed <= 16
+        assert expected_committed + query_len <= 20
+        assert context.plan_ring_start.item() == 0
+        assert context.plan_flush_count.item() == -1
+        computed = computed_after
+    assert checkpoint_tokens >= 40  # Exercise more than one physical ring wrap.

+def _metric_counts(llm) -> dict[str, int]:
+    return {
+        metric.name: metric.value
+        for metric in llm.get_metrics()
+        if isinstance(metric, Counter)

+def _stress_mamba_block_size(worker) -> int:
+    from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import MambaSpec, iter_layer_specs
+
+    sizes = {
+        spec.block_size
+        for group in worker.model_runner.kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups
+        for spec in iter_layer_specs(group.kv_cache_spec)
+        if isinstance(spec, MambaSpec)
+    }
+    assert len(sizes) == 1, sizes
+    return sizes.pop()

+def _generate_with_preemption(llm, block_size: int):
+    """Preempt active requests, then complete decode across three cache blocks."""
+    engine = llm.llm_engine
+    # MTP excludes one trailing block from prefix hits. Keep three reusable
+    # blocks, plus that proof block and a decode margin.
+    max_tokens = 4 * block_size + 64
+    requests = {
+        "short": ("The capital of France is", 256),
+        "long": (
+            "Write a detailed history of mathematics, starting in antiquity.",
+            max_tokens,
+        ),
+    }
+    prompt_length = len(llm.get_tokenizer().encode(requests["long"][0]))
+    assert (
+        prompt_length + max_tokens + 8 <= engine.vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len
+    )
+    before = _metric_counts(llm)
+    # Queue both requests before scheduling either engine's initial batch.
+    llm.sleep(level=0, mode="keep")
+    try:
+        for request_id, (prompt, length) in requests.items():
+            engine.add_request(
+                request_id,
+                prompt,
+                SamplingParams(temperature=0.0, max_tokens=length, ignore_eos=True),
+            )
+    finally:
+        llm.wake_up(tags=["scheduling"])
+    latest = {}
+    preempted = False
+    observed_turnover = False
+    for _ in range(max_tokens + 1024):
+        for output in engine.step():
+            latest[output.request_id] = output
+        if len(latest) != len(requests):
+            continue
+        short, long = latest["short"], latest["long"]
+        if not preempted and len(long.outputs[0].token_ids) >= 32:
+            assert not short.finished and not long.finished
+            assert llm.reset_prefix_cache(reset_running_requests=True)
+            preempted = True
+        observed_turnover |= short.finished and not long.finished
+        if all(output.finished for output in latest.values()):
+            break
+    assert preempted and observed_turnover
+    assert all(output.finished for output in latest.values())
+    after = _metric_counts(llm)
+    assert after["vllm:num_preemptions"] - before["vllm:num_preemptions"] >= 2
+    for request_id, (_, length) in requests.items():
+        output = latest[request_id]
+        completion = output.outputs[0]
+        assert len(completion.token_ids) == length
+        assert completion.finish_reason == "length"
+        if request_id == "long":
+            prompt_len = len(output.prompt_token_ids)
+            crossed = (prompt_len + length - 1) // block_size - prompt_len // block_size
+            assert crossed >= 3, (prompt_len, length, block_size, crossed)
+            print(
+                f"ReplaySSM stress: block_size={block_size}, crossings={crossed}, "
+                "preemptions="
+                f"{after['vllm:num_preemptions'] - before['vllm:num_preemptions']}"
+            )
+    long = latest["long"]
+    assert long.prompt_token_ids is not None
+    history = long.prompt_token_ids + list(long.outputs[0].token_ids)

+    )

+        "vllm:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens", 0
+    )
+    assert 0 < accepted < drafted, (accepted, drafted)
+    return history

+def initialize_replayssm_ring_trackers(
+    kv_cache_config: KVCacheConfig,
+    forward_context: Mapping[str, Any],
+) -> None:
+    """Allocate and bind one tracker pair per ReplaySSM cache group."""
+    for group in kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups:
+        names = [
+            name
+            for name in group.layer_names
+            if isinstance(layer := forward_context.get(name), MambaBase)
+            and layer.use_replayssm
+        ]
+        if not names:
+            continue
+        layers = [forward_context[name] for name in names]
+        state = layers[0].kv_cache[0]
+        num_blocks, device = state.shape[0], state.device
+        trackers = (
+            layers[0]._replayssm_ring_start,
+            layers[0]._replayssm_prev_num_accepted,
+        )
+        # Extensible caches rebind after capture. Keep the captured addresses.
+        if all(
+            t.numel() >= num_blocks and t.device == device for t in trackers
+        ) and all(
+            layer._replayssm_ring_start is trackers[0]
+            and layer._replayssm_prev_num_accepted is trackers[1]
+            for layer in layers
+        ):
+            ring_start, num_committed = (t[:num_blocks] for t in trackers)
+        else:
+            ring_start = torch.zeros(num_blocks, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+            num_committed = torch.zeros_like(ring_start)
+        for layer in layers:
+            layer._replayssm_ring_start = ring_start
+            layer._replayssm_prev_num_accepted = num_committed
+            layer._plans_replayssm_decode = False
+        # Triton plans each decode step in the group's first executed layer.
+        planner = min(names, key=extract_layer_index)
+        forward_context[planner]._plans_replayssm_decode = True

+    forward_context: Mapping[str, Any],

+    """Include shared trackers in scheduler block copies alongside packed pages."""
+    tensors: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+    for layer in forward_context.values():

+            tensors.extend(

+def _compact_replayssm_requests_kernel(
+    plan_flush_count,
+    active_request_indices,
+    num_reqs,
+    MAX_NUM_REQS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+) -> None:
+    """Build the shared FlashInfer active-request list."""
+    offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
+    in_capacity = offsets < MAX_NUM_REQS
+    active = (offsets < num_reqs) & (
+        tl.load(plan_flush_count + offsets, mask=in_capacity, other=-1) >= 0
+    )
+    active_i32 = active.to(tl.int32)
+    output_offsets = tl.cumsum(active_i32, axis=0) - 1
+    num_active = tl.sum(active_i32, axis=0)
+    tl.store(
+        active_request_indices + output_offsets,
+        offsets,
+        mask=in_capacity & active,
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        active_request_indices + offsets,
+        -1,
+        mask=in_capacity & (offsets >= num_active),
+    )

+    @classmethod
+    def create(
+        cls,
+        grouped: Sequence[tuple[list[Any], MambaSpec, torch.Tensor]],
+        max_num_reqs: int,

+        mixers = [mixer for group, _, _ in grouped for mixer in group]
+        first = mixers[0]
+        first_spec = grouped[0][1]

+            dtype=torch.int32,

+            num_committed_ptrs=_cuda_i64_ptrs(

+            dst_slots_ptrs=_cuda_i64_ptrs(

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.triton_utils import tldevice as libdevice
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["size"])
+def _silu_mul_kernel(X, Y, size, width: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
+    i = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    src = i // width * (2 * width) + i % width
+    gate = tl.load(X + src, i < size, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    up = tl.load(X + src + width, i < size, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    act = tl.div_rn(gate, 1.0 + libdevice.exp(-gate))
+    tl.store(Y + i, act * up, i < size)
+
+
+def beam_silu_mul(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Compute SiLU and multiplication in FP32, rounding only the product."""
+    width = x.shape[-1] // 2
+    output = torch.empty((*x.shape[:-1], width), dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)
+    if output.numel():
+        _silu_mul_kernel[(triton.cdiv(output.numel(), 1024),)](
+            x, output, output.numel(), width, 1024, enable_fp_fusion=False
+        )
+    return output
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _softcap_logits_kernel(
+    X,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    CAP: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    col = tl.program_id(1) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    x = tl.load(X + row * STRIDE + col, col < WIDTH, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    y = libdevice.tanh(x * (1.0 / CAP)) * CAP
+    tl.store(X + row * STRIDE + col, y, col < WIDTH)
+
+
+def beam_softcap_logits(logits: torch.Tensor, cap: float) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Softcap in FP32 and round back into the original logits buffer."""
+    assert logits.ndim == 2 and logits.stride(1) == 1
+    if logits.numel():
+        _softcap_logits_kernel[(logits.shape[0], triton.cdiv(logits.shape[1], 1024))](
+            logits,
+            logits.shape[1],
+            logits.stride(0),
+            cap,
+            1024,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return logits

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.config import CacheConfig
+from vllm.distributed import get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention import Attention
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import (
+    ColumnParallelLinear,
+    MergedColumnParallelLinear,
+    QKVParallelLinear,
+    RowParallelLinear,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization import QuantizationConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.rotary_embedding import get_rope
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.weight_utils import sharded_weight_loader
+from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import extract_layer_index
+from vllm.model_executor.utils import set_weight_attrs
+from vllm.transformers_utils.configs.beam import BeamConfig
+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import AttentionType
+
+from .attention_ops import beam_output_gate, beam_qk_norm_rope
+from .layernorm import RMSNorm
+
+
+def use_merged_qkv_gate(config: BeamConfig, tp_size: int) -> bool:
+    return config.num_key_value_heads >= tp_size
+
+
+class BeamAttention(nn.Module):
+    """Beam GQA using standard vLLM projections and attention dispatch."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: BeamConfig,
+        cache_config: CacheConfig | None,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        reduce_results: bool = True,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.layer_id = extract_layer_index(prefix)
+        hidden_size = config.hidden_size
+        tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        self.total_num_heads = config.num_attention_heads
+        assert self.total_num_heads % tp_size == 0
+        self.num_heads = self.total_num_heads // tp_size
+        self.total_num_kv_heads = config.num_key_value_heads
+        if self.total_num_kv_heads >= tp_size:
+            assert self.total_num_kv_heads % tp_size == 0
+        else:
+            assert tp_size % self.total_num_kv_heads == 0
+        self.num_kv_heads = max(1, self.total_num_kv_heads // tp_size)
+        self.head_dim = config.head_dim or (hidden_size // self.total_num_heads)
+        self.q_size = self.num_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.kv_size = self.num_kv_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.scaling = self.head_dim**-0.5
+
+        self.merged_qkv_gate = use_merged_qkv_gate(config, tp_size)
+        if self.merged_qkv_gate:
+            self.qkv_gate_proj = MergedColumnParallelLinear(
+                hidden_size,
+                [
+                    self.total_num_heads * self.head_dim,
+                    self.total_num_kv_heads * self.head_dim,
+                    self.total_num_kv_heads * self.head_dim,
+                    self.total_num_heads * self.head_dim,
+                ],
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.qkv_gate_proj",
+            )
+        else:
+            self.qkv_proj = QKVParallelLinear(
+                hidden_size,
+                self.head_dim,
+                self.total_num_heads,
+                self.total_num_kv_heads,
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.qkv_proj",
+            )
+        self.o_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            self.total_num_heads * self.head_dim,
+            hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.o_proj",
+            reduce_results=reduce_results,
+        )
+
+        self.rms_norm_eps = config.rms_norm_eps
+        self.q_norm = RMSNorm(self.head_dim)
+        self.k_norm = RMSNorm(self.head_dim)
+
+        self.disable_rope = config.layer_types[self.layer_id] == "full_attention"
+        if not self.merged_qkv_gate:
+            self.output_gate_proj = ColumnParallelLinear(
+                hidden_size,
+                self.total_num_heads * self.head_dim,
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.output_gate_proj",
+            )
+        self.gate_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(self.num_heads))
+        set_weight_attrs(self.gate_bias, {"weight_loader": sharded_weight_loader(0)})
+
+        if self.disable_rope:
+            self.rotary_emb = None
+        else:
+            self.rotary_emb = get_rope(
+                self.head_dim,
+                max_position=config.max_position_embeddings,
+                is_neox_style=True,
+                rope_parameters=config.rope_parameters,
+                dtype=torch.float32,
+            )
+
+        is_sliding = config.layer_types[self.layer_id] == "sliding_attention"
+        per_layer_sw = config.sliding_window if is_sliding else None
+        self.attn = Attention(
+            self.num_heads,
+            self.head_dim,
+            self.scaling,
+            num_kv_heads=self.num_kv_heads,
+            cache_config=cache_config,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            per_layer_sliding_window=per_layer_sw,
+            attn_type=AttentionType.DECODER,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.attn",
+        )
+
+        backend = self.attn.attn_backend
+        self.fuse_kv_insert = (
+            not backend.forward_includes_kv_cache_update
+            and backend.supports_kv_cache_update_bypass
+            and self.attn.impl.dcp_world_size == 1
+            and self.attn.kv_sharing_target_layer_name is None
+            and self.attn.kv_cache_dtype in ("auto", "bfloat16")
+        )
+        self.attn.kv_cache_update_bypass = self.fuse_kv_insert
+
+    def forward(
+        self, positions: torch.Tensor, hidden_states: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        gate = None
+        if self.merged_qkv_gate:
+            packed, _ = self.qkv_gate_proj(hidden_states)
+            qkv, gate = packed.split(
+                [self.q_size + 2 * self.kv_size, self.q_size], dim=-1
+            )
+        else:
+            qkv, _ = self.qkv_proj(hidden_states)
+            gate, _ = self.output_gate_proj(hidden_states)
+        q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+
+        kv_cache, slot_mapping = None, None
+        if (
+            self.fuse_kv_insert
+            and self.attn.kv_cache.dtype == q.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        ):
+            slots = get_forward_context().slot_mapping
+            if isinstance(slots, dict):
+                slot_mapping = slots.get(self.attn.layer_name)
+                if slot_mapping is not None:
+                    kv_cache = self.attn.kv_cache
+
+        rope = self.rotary_emb
+        q, k = beam_qk_norm_rope(
+            q,
+            k,
+            self.q_norm.weight,
+            self.k_norm.weight,
+            self.rms_norm_eps,
+            positions,
+            rope.cos_sin_cache if rope is not None else None,
+            self.head_dim,
+            rope.rotary_dim if rope is not None else 0,
+            rope.is_neox_style if rope is not None else True,
+            ssmax=self.disable_rope,
+            value=v,
+            kv_cache=kv_cache,
+            slot_mapping=slot_mapping,
+        )
+
+        attn_output = (
+            self.attn(q, k, v) if kv_cache is None else self.attn(q, None, None)
+        )
+        attn_output = beam_output_gate(
+            attn_output,
+            gate,
+            self.gate_bias,
+            num_heads=self.num_heads,
+            head_dim=self.head_dim,
+            floor=0.0,
+            temperature=1.0,
+        )
+        output, _ = self.o_proj(attn_output)
+        return output

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Fused Q/K normalization, position transforms, and attention output gating."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.triton_utils import tldevice as libdevice
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["SIZE"])
+def _output_gate_kernel(
+    X,
+    G,
+    B,
+    Y,
+    SIZE,
+    G_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    FLOOR: tl.constexpr,
+    TEMPERATURE: tl.constexpr,
+    BIAS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    i = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    dtype = G.dtype.element_ty
+    g_idx = i // (HEADS * DIM) * G_STRIDE + i % (HEADS * DIM)
+    g = tl.load(G + g_idx, i < SIZE, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    if BIAS:
+        b = tl.load(B + i // DIM % HEADS).to(tl.float32)
+        g = (g + b).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    g = (g / TEMPERATURE).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    sigmoid = (1.0 / (1.0 + tl.exp(-g))).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    multiplier = (sigmoid * (1.0 - FLOOR)).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    multiplier = (multiplier + FLOOR).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    x = tl.load(X + i, i < SIZE, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(Y + i, x * multiplier, i < SIZE)
+
+
+def beam_output_gate(
+    attn_output: torch.Tensor,
+    gate: torch.Tensor,
+    gate_bias: torch.Tensor | None,
+    *,
+    num_heads: int,
+    head_dim: int,
+    floor: float = 0.0,
+    temperature: float = 1.0,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Fuse gate operations while retaining activation-dtype rounding."""
+    output = torch.empty_like(attn_output)
+    if output.numel():
+        _output_gate_kernel[(triton.cdiv(output.numel(), 256),)](
+            attn_output,
+            gate,
+            gate_bias,
+            output,
+            output.numel(),
+            gate.stride(0),
+            num_heads,
+            head_dim,
+            floor,
+            temperature,
+            gate_bias is not None,
+            256,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return output
+
+
+@triton.jit(
+    do_not_specialize=["M", "NUM_SLOTS"], do_not_specialize_on_alignment=["POS"]
+)
+def _qk_norm_rope_kernel(
+    Q,
+    K,
+    QW,
+    KW,
+    POS,
+    CACHE,
+    OQ,
+    OK,
+    M,
+    V,
+    KV_CACHE,
+    SLOTS,
+    NUM_SLOTS,
+    WRITE_CACHE: tl.constexpr,
+    V_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    CACHE_BLOCK_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    CACHE_HEAD_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    CACHE_TOKEN_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    PAGE_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    TOKENS: tl.constexpr,
+    Q_HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    K_HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    Q_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    K_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    ROTARY: tl.constexpr,
+    NEOX: tl.constexpr,
+    SSMAX: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    token = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64) * TOKENS + tl.arange(0, TOKENS)
+    head = tl.program_id(1)
+    c = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = (token[:, None] < M) & (c[None, :] < DIM)
+    if head < Q_HEADS:
+        x = tl.load(
+            Q + token[:, None] * Q_STRIDE + head * DIM + c[None, :], mask, 0
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        if BLOCK == 128:
+            squares = (x * x).reshape((TOKENS, 4, 32))
+            total = tl.sum(tl.sum(squares, 2), 1)
+        else:
+            total = tl.sum(x * x, 1)
+        y = x * tl.rsqrt(total / DIM + EPS)[:, None]
+        y = y * tl.load(QW + c, c < DIM, 0).to(tl.float32)[None, :]
+        out = OQ + (token[:, None] * Q_HEADS + head) * DIM
+    else:
+        h = head - Q_HEADS
+        x = tl.load(K + token[:, None] * K_STRIDE + h * DIM + c[None, :], mask, 0).to(
+            tl.float32
+        )
+        if BLOCK == 128:
+            squares = (x * x).reshape((TOKENS, 4, 32))
+            total = tl.sum(tl.sum(squares, 2), 1)
+        else:
+            total = tl.sum(x * x, 1)
+        y = x * tl.rsqrt(total / DIM + EPS)[:, None]
+        y = y * tl.load(KW + c, c < DIM, 0).to(tl.float32)[None, :]
+        out = OK + (token[:, None] * K_HEADS + h) * DIM
+    y = y.to(Q.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    if ROTARY:
+        half: tl.constexpr = ROTARY // 2
+        if NEOX:
+            partner = tl.where(c < half, c + half, c - half)
+            second = c >= half
+            offset = c % half
+        else:
+            partner = c ^ 1
+            second = c % 2 != 0
+            offset = c // 2
+        partner = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(partner, 0), BLOCK - 1)
+        other = tl.gather(y, tl.broadcast_to(partner[None, :], (TOKENS, BLOCK)), axis=1)
+        pos = tl.load(POS + token, token < M, 0).to(tl.int64)
+        rope_mask = (token[:, None] < M) & (c[None, :] < ROTARY)
+        cos = tl.load(CACHE + pos[:, None] * ROTARY + offset[None, :], rope_mask, 0)
+        sin = tl.load(
+            CACHE + pos[:, None] * ROTARY + half + offset[None, :], rope_mask, 0
+        )
+        rotated = tl.where(
+            second[None, :],
+            tl.fma(other, sin, y * cos),
+            tl.fma(y, cos, -other * sin),
+        )
+        y = tl.where(c[None, :] < ROTARY, rotated, y)
+    elif SSMAX:
+        if head < Q_HEADS:
+            # (1 + (position + 1) / 2048) ** 0.1
+            p = tl.load(POS + token, token < M, 0).to(tl.float32) + 1
+            scale = libdevice.exp(0.1 * libdevice.log1p(p / 2048.0))
+            y = y * scale[:, None]
+    tl.store(out + c[None, :], y, mask)
+    if WRITE_CACHE and head >= Q_HEADS:
+        slot = tl.load(SLOTS + token, token < NUM_SLOTS, -1).to(tl.int64)
+        cache_mask = mask & (token[:, None] < NUM_SLOTS) & (slot[:, None] >= 0)
+        address = (
+            slot[:, None] // PAGE_SIZE * CACHE_BLOCK_STRIDE
+            + slot[:, None] % PAGE_SIZE * CACHE_TOKEN_STRIDE
+            + (head - Q_HEADS) * CACHE_HEAD_STRIDE
+            + c[None, :]
+        )
+        tl.store(KV_CACHE + address, y, cache_mask)
+        value = tl.load(
+            V + token[:, None] * V_STRIDE + (head - Q_HEADS) * DIM + c[None, :],
+            cache_mask,
+            0,
+        )
+        tl.store(KV_CACHE + address + DIM, value, cache_mask)
+
+
+def beam_qk_norm_rope(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    q_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    k_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor | None,
+    head_dim: int,
+    rotary_dim: int = 0,
+    is_neox_style: bool = True,
+    *,
+    ssmax: bool = False,
+    value: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    kv_cache: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    slot_mapping: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Round norm before position transforms and optionally insert BF16 K/V."""
+    if kv_cache is not None:
+        assert value is not None and slot_mapping is not None
+        assert kv_cache.dtype == q.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        assert kv_cache.ndim == 4 and kv_cache.stride(-1) == 1
+    q_out, k_out = torch.empty_like(q), torch.empty_like(k)
+    q_heads, k_heads = q.shape[-1] // head_dim, k.shape[-1] // head_dim
+    if q.shape[0]:
+        if rotary_dim or q.shape[0] < 512:
+            tile, warps = 4, 4
+        elif q.shape[0] <= 2048:
+            tile, warps = 16, 8
+        else:
+            tile, warps = 32, 4
+        _qk_norm_rope_kernel[(triton.cdiv(q.shape[0], tile), q_heads + k_heads)](
+            q,
+            k,
+            q_weight,
+            k_weight,
+            positions,
+            cos_sin_cache,
+            q_out,
+            k_out,
+            q.shape[0],
+            value,
+            kv_cache,
+            slot_mapping,
+            slot_mapping.numel() if slot_mapping is not None else 0,
+            kv_cache is not None,
+            value.stride(0) if value is not None else 0,
+            kv_cache.stride(0) if kv_cache is not None else 0,
+            kv_cache.stride(1) if kv_cache is not None else 0,
+            kv_cache.stride(2) if kv_cache is not None else 0,
+            kv_cache.shape[2] if kv_cache is not None else 1,
+            tile,
+            q_heads,
+            k_heads,
+            head_dim,
+            q.stride(0),
+            k.stride(0),
+            eps,
+            rotary_dim,
+            is_neox_style,
+            ssmax,
+            triton.next_power_of_2(head_dim),
+            num_warps=warps,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return q_out, k_out

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""DFlash2 draft model for Beam targets.
+
+A DFlash2 drafter predicts a block of tokens at once from hidden states the
+Beam target captures at `dflash_config.target_layer_ids`, then a low-rank
+candidate selector rescores the top-k tokens at each block position against
+the token before it. The drafter shares the target's embeddings and LM head.
+
+Nothing here is torch-compiled. The DFlash speculator captures the whole draft
+step (decoder layers, candidate head and selector) in its own CUDA graphs, and
+the context K/V precompute runs eagerly as a few fused kernels.
+"""
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+from vllm.config import CacheConfig, VllmConfig, get_current_vllm_config
+from vllm.distributed import get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.activation import SiluAndMul
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention import Attention
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.layernorm import RMSNorm
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import (
+    MergedColumnParallelLinear,
+    QKVParallelLinear,
+    ReplicatedLinear,
+    RowParallelLinear,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.logits_processor import LogitsProcessor
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.rotary_embedding import get_rope
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import (
+    ParallelLMHead,
+    VocabParallelEmbedding,

+class DFlash2BeamAttention(nn.Module):
+    """Query-token attention; the context K/V is already in the KV cache."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config,
+        layer_idx: int,
+        cache_config: CacheConfig | None,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        hidden_size = config.hidden_size
+        tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        total_num_heads = config.num_attention_heads
+        total_num_kv_heads = config.num_key_value_heads
+        assert total_num_heads % tp_size == 0
+        if total_num_kv_heads >= tp_size:
+            assert total_num_kv_heads % tp_size == 0
+        else:
+            assert tp_size % total_num_kv_heads == 0
+        self.num_heads = total_num_heads // tp_size
+        self.num_kv_heads = max(1, total_num_kv_heads // tp_size)
+        self.head_dim = config.head_dim
+        self.q_size = self.num_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.kv_size = self.num_kv_heads * self.head_dim
+        # Every layer is non-causal sliding-window attention over the block.
+        assert config.layer_types[layer_idx] == "sliding_attention"
+        assert not config.is_causal
+        self.causal = False
+
+        self.qkv_proj = QKVParallelLinear(
+            hidden_size,
+            self.head_dim,
+            total_num_heads,
+            total_num_kv_heads,
+            bias=False,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.qkv_proj",
+        )
+        self.o_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            total_num_heads * self.head_dim,
+            hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.o_proj",
+        )
+        self.rotary_emb = get_rope(
+            self.head_dim,
+            max_position=config.max_position_embeddings,
+            is_neox_style=True,
+            rope_parameters=config.rope_parameters,
+        )
+        self.attn = Attention(
+            self.num_heads,
+            self.head_dim,
+            self.head_dim**-0.5,
+            num_kv_heads=self.num_kv_heads,
+            cache_config=cache_config,
+            per_layer_sliding_window=config.sliding_window,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.attn",
+        )
+        backend = self.attn.attn_backend
+        self.fuse_kv_insert = (
+            not backend.forward_includes_kv_cache_update
+            and backend.supports_kv_cache_update_bypass
+            and self.attn.impl.dcp_world_size == 1
+            and self.attn.kv_sharing_target_layer_name is None
+            and self.attn.kv_cache_dtype in ("auto", "bfloat16")
+        )
+        self.attn.kv_cache_update_bypass = self.fuse_kv_insert
+        self.q_norm = RMSNorm(self.head_dim, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.k_norm = RMSNorm(self.head_dim, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.v_scale = config.dflash_config.get("attention_value_scale")
+
+    def forward(
+        self, positions: torch.Tensor, hidden_states: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        from .attention_ops import beam_qk_norm_rope
+
+        qkv, _ = self.qkv_proj(hidden_states)
+        q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+        if self.v_scale is not None:
+            v = v * self.v_scale
+        cache, slots = None, None
+        mapping = get_forward_context().slot_mapping
+        assert isinstance(mapping, dict)
+        if (
+            self.fuse_kv_insert
+            and mapping
+            and self.attn.kv_cache.dtype == q.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        ):
+            slots = mapping[self.attn.layer_name]
+            cache = self.attn.kv_cache
+            assert cache.dtype == q.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            assert cache.ndim == 4
+        rope = self.rotary_emb
+        q, k = beam_qk_norm_rope(
+            q,
+            k,
+            self.q_norm.weight,
+            self.k_norm.weight,
+            self.q_norm.variance_epsilon,
+            positions,
+            rope.cos_sin_cache,
+            self.head_dim,
+            rope.rotary_dim,
+            rope.is_neox_style,
+            value=v,
+            kv_cache=cache,
+            slot_mapping=slots,
+        )
+        output = self.attn(q, k, v) if cache is None else self.attn(q, None, None)
+        output, _ = self.o_proj(output)
+        return output
+

+class DFlash2BeamMLP(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, hidden_size: int, intermediate_size: int, prefix: str) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.gate_up_proj = MergedColumnParallelLinear(
+            hidden_size,
+            [intermediate_size] * 2,
+            bias=False,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.gate_up_proj",
+        )
+        self.down_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            intermediate_size,
+            hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.down_proj",
+        )
+        self.act_fn = SiluAndMul()
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        x, _ = self.gate_up_proj(x)
+        x, _ = self.down_proj(self.act_fn(x))
+        return x
+
